Message:
drm/amd/display: Fix potential NULL and mem leak in create_links

Found by smatch:
drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/../display/dc/core/dc.c:148 create_links()
error: potential null dereference 'link->link_enc'.  (kzalloc returns
null)
